In `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`, `askDM` (line 81) catches a call failure to `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`, retries once with `@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`; if that also throws, it returns `fallbackNarrative(playerAction)` directly.

If a model does respond, the raw text goes to `parseAIResponse(raw, playerAction)`, which:
- returns `fallbackNarrative` immediately if `raw` is empty/non-string,
- strips ```` ```json ```` fences and extracts the first `{...}` block, falling back to `fallbackNarrative` if no JSON-like block is found,
- `JSON.parse`s the cleaned text inside a try/catch — on parse error it again returns `fallbackNarrative`.

`fallbackNarrative(playerAction)` builds a canned `AIDMResponse`: a generic narrative string ("You attempt to ... The world shifts around you..."), null `gameStateChanges`, default `suggestedActions` (`['Look around','Proceed carefully','Listen for sounds','Rest a moment']`), and empty `diceRolls` — so gameplay never breaks even when the AI fails or returns malformed JSON.
